experiment: E6 — fresh stories, prompt v4, article-aware planner + hierarchical model (A49)

questions.Q1_planner: Does the article-aware planner spread verdicts over more distinct articles than E4's flat planner (E4 all-countries part, v3, calls after 2026-10-11T14:08:14Z)? Metrics per run: mean and max uses per judged article, share of calls that reuse an article already judged in the run, distinct articles per 100 calls. Expected: lower mean and max uses, more distinct articles per 100 calls. Descriptive only — prompt and stories differ.
questions.Q2_fresh_allsides: Out of sample for v4: hierarchical fit on E6 calls only, social axis, Spearman with the same 14 AllSides ratings (docs/experiments/e4_prereg.json). Target >= 0.6. If fewer than 10 rated outlets have >= 5 decisive verdicts in E6: 'undecided (too little data)'. Secondary: all v4 data (E4b + E6).
questions.Q3_contrasts: Same 20 contrasts as E4, hierarchical fit on all v4 data: >= 80 % of decided confirmed (P > 0.8 confirmed, < 0.2 contradicted).
questions.Q4_split_half: US/UK, all v4 data, hierarchical, mean Spearman over 30 random halvings (by call). Exploratory target >= 0.5.

rules: No prompt change during or after the run on the basis of these results without a new pre-registration. No claims (pipeline phase).
